newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds follow higher U.S. lead.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds follow higher U.S. lead.

text.p: High protein soymeal price rose by around one stg a tonne on the UK meals and feeds market on Tuesday following gains in Chicago.
Traders said business was again slow, but nearby high protein soymeal supplies on the east and south coast were getting tight.
"We know shippers are trying to get cover from the stores, but we can't get details," said a trader.
"Spot material is trading at over 200 stg a tonne on the south and east coast, but that is all we can find out," said another. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8062
